player_prompt.intro:
I ka jɛ Tower of Hanoi ye {num_disks} kɔnɔnɛnɛw.
I ka na kɔnɔnɛnɛw ye sɛbɛn A ka su sɛbɛn C.
Kɔnɔnɛnɛn ye, ala sɛbɛn inɛnɛ ye, sɛbɛn inɛnɛ (mɔgɔ, '[A C]').
Jɛlen, i ka na kɔnɔnɛnɛn ye, kɔnɔnɛnɛn dɔrɔn, kɔnɔnɛnɛn dɔrɔn ka kɛ sɛbɛn kɔrɔ, kɔnɔnɛnɛn dɔrɔn kɛra ka kɛ sɛbɛn dɔrɔn.
Kɛlɛnkɛlɛn, i ka taa kɔnɔnɛnɛn kɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I ka se a fɔlɛ '[source] [target]' ye.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Aw ye kunnafonisira walima kɔrɔsili jɔyɔrɔ min tɛ bɛn ni o ye.
invalid_move.empty_tower: I ye disiki dɔ ta ka bɔ sankanso lakolon kɔnɔ.
invalid_move.same_tower: I ye disiki dɔ bila ka taa o sankanso kelen na.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: I ye disiki belebeleba bila disiki fitini kan.

game_action.moved: I ka ca {disk} kɔnɔnɛnɛw ye {source} ka su {target}.

outcome.win: I ye Hanoi ka sankaso kuncɛko ɲɛnabɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: I ye disiki {pct}% bila ka ɲɛ C sankaso kan.
